Regeneration therefore reproduces the identical D2 row and the span-seam provenance stays absent from the bundle.

discriminating_question: Is the accepted v66 content-quality filter present on the shipped slice's counter-evidence emission path at all, or was the shipped slice simply generated before the filter landed?
product_decision_unlocked: If H1, the cheapest product repair is to route the offline/server slice generation through the filtered span seam (or emit slice bundles through the non-fixture audit path) rather than to regenerate artifacts; regeneration alone cannot clear D2. If H0, regeneration alone clears D2. Either answer converts REPAIR_NOT_CONFIRMED into an actionable, minimal product fix.
